content: Yesuusa Bolla Maqetidosona
Paasika Ba7aale bonchiya gallasinne Uytha Ba7aale bonchiya gallasi gakanaw nam7u gallasi attis. Kahine halaqatinne higge astamaareti asi eronna Yesuusa oykidi wodhiya oge koyoosona.
“Asay ooshshi kessonna mela Paasika bonchiya gallasan hessa oothoko” yaagidosona.
Yesuusa Shitto Tiyida Maccasiw

Yesuusi Bitaane kataman baro hargancho gidida Simoona son gibira bolla uttidashin, issi maccasiya albasxiroosa shuchafe oosetida philqaaxe kumetha nardoose geetetiya daro al7o shitto ekada yasu. He philqaaxe menthada shittuwa Yesuusa huuphen tigasu.
He bessan de7iya asape issoy issoy hanqetidi, “Ha shittoy mela coo iitey aybisee?
Ha shittuwa heedzu xeetu dinaaren
bayzidi, miishiya manqotas immanaw danda7etees” yaagidi banta giddon odetidosona. Yaatidi, he maccasiw daro boridosona.
Shin Yesuusi “Ha maccasiw aykoka goopite; iyo ayis waaysetii? Iya taw lo77oba oothasu.
Manqoti ubba wode hintera de7oosona. Hinte koyida wode awudeka hinte enta maaddanaw danda7eeta, shin taani ubba wode hintera de7ike.
Iya ba danda7idaysa oothasu; qassi tana moogoos giigisanaw kasetada shitto tiyasu.
Taani hintew tuma odayis; sa7a ubban wongela odiya bessa awunka, asay iyo akeekana mela ha iya oothidaysi odetana” yaagis.
Yihudi Yesuusa Aathidi Imuwa
Tammanne nam7u tamaaretape issoy Asqoroota Yihuda geeteteysi Yesuusa kahine halaqatas aathidi immanaw entako bis.
Enti hessa si7ida wode ufaytidi, “Nuuni new miishe immana” yaagidosona; Yihudi Yesuusa aathidi immanaw inje wode koyees.
Godaa Kahuwa
Uytha miya gallas bonchiya koyro gallas, Paasika katha maanaw maraze shukiya wode, Yesuusa tamaareti iyako, “Paasika bonchiya gallas neeni maana katha nuuni aw bidi giigisino?” gidi oychidosona.
Yesuusi ba tamaaretape nam7ata haysada yaagidi kiittis: “Katamaa biite; hinte bishin, otora haathe tookida issi uray hintera gahetana; iya kaallite.
I bidi geliya keetha godaa, ‘Astamaarey neeko, “Taani ta tamaaretara Paasika maanaw imatha kifiley awunee?” yaagees’ yaagite.
Goday hintena pooqiya bolla de7iya giigidi uttida dalga kifile bessaana; hessan giigisite” yaagis.
He nam7u tamaareti keyidi, katama bidosona; Yesuusi entaw odidaysada demmidi, Paasika kathi giigisidosona.
Sa7ay omarsiya wode Yesuusi tammanne nam7u tamaaretara yaa bis.
Enti uttidi kathi mishin, Yesuusi entako, “Taani hintew tuma odayis; hintefe issoy taara meysi, tana aathidi immana” yaagis.
Iya tamaareti dagammidi, banta huuphen huuphen, “Tuma taneshsha?” yaagidi iya oychidosona.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “He uray, hinte tammanne nam7atape issuwa; I taara issife tushanaw ba uytha shaaten yeddeysa.
Asa Na7ay, Geeshsha Maxaafay hayqana gidaysada hayqana, shin Asa Na7a, aathidi immiya ura ayye! He uray yeletonna attidaako iyaw lo77oshin” yaagis.
Enti mishin, Yesuusi uythaa ekidi, Xoossaa galatis; he uytha menthidi, ba tamaaretas immishe, “He7ite, haysi ta ashuwa” yaagis.
Xuu7a ekidi, Xoossaa galatidi, entaw immin ubbayka he xuu7ape uyidosona.
Yesuusi, “Haysi ooratha caaquwan daro asaa gisho gukiya ta suutha.
Taani hintew tuma odayis; taani Xoossaa kawotethan ooratha woyne uyana gallasi gakanaw zaarada ha woyniyape uyike” yaagis.
Mazmure yexidaape guye, Shamaho zuma bolla bidosona.
Phexroosi Yesuusa Kaddanaysi Odetis
Yesuusi entako, “Hinte ubbay tana yeggi aggidi baqatana; Geeshsha Maxaafay,
yaagees.
Shin taani hayqope dendidaape guye, hintefe sinthatada Galila baana” yaagis.
Phexroosi zaaridi, “Enti ubbay nena yeggi aggidi baqatikoka, ta nena aggike” yaagis.
Yesuusi Phexroosako, “Taani new tuma odayis; hachi qamma kuttoy nam7u toho waassanaape sinthe neeni tana heedzu toho kaddana” yaagis.
Shin Phexroosi kaseysafe minthidi, “Taani hari attoshin, neera issife hayqiyakoka, nena kaddike” yaagis. Qassi harati ubbatika hessada gidoosona.
Yesuusi Geetasamanen Woossis
Geetasemaane geetetiya bessaa bidosona; Yesuusi ba tamaaretako, “Taani Xoossaa woossada simmana gakanaw hinte haysan uttishite” yaagis.
Yesuusi Phexroosa, Yayqoobanne Yohaanisa baara ekidi bis; daro waayetisinne un7etis.
Qassi entako, “Taani hayqana gakanaw azzanas, haysan gam7ishite; dhiskofite” yaagis.
Guuthi sinthe shiiqidi, sa7an gufannidi, danda7etiyaba gidiko, he waayiya saatey baape aadhana mela, Xoossa woossis.
Qassi, “Abba, ta Aawaw, ubbabay new danda7etees, ha waaye xuu7aa taape digga. Shin ne sheney hanope attishin, ta sheney hanopo” yaagis.
Yesuusi ba tamaaretako simmi yidi, enti dhiskidashin demmidi, Phexroosako, “Simoona, dhiskadii? Neeni issi saateka barkada naaganaw danda7abikii?
Paacen hinte gelonna mela barkidi naagitenne Xoossaa woossite. Hintew lo77o amoy de7ees, shin hinte daaburancho asi” yaagis.
Qassika bidi kaseysada Xoossa woossis.
Ba tamaaretako guye simmidi yaa wode, dhiskidashin demmis. Enta ayfiya dhiskoy goozi wothida gisho, iyako ay odetiyakoka erokona.
Heedzantho entako yidi, “Ha77i gakanawuka dhisketinne shempetii? Hiza, gidana; saatey gakis; be7ite! Asa Na7ay, nagarancho asaas aadhidi imetana wodey gakis.
Dendidi yedhite; be7ite, tana aathidi immanaysi gakis” yaagis.
Yesuusa Oyketetha

Yesuusi hessa buroo odishin, tammanne nam7u iya tamaaretape issoy, Yihudi, ellesidi gaki wodhis. Qassi kahine halaqati, higge astamaaretinne cimati kiittin, mashshanne xam7a oykida daro asay iyara issife yidosona.
Yesuusa aathidi immanaysi he daro asaas, “Taani yeeriya uray iya; iya oykidi, loythi naagidi efite” yaagidi malla odi wothis.
Yihudi gaki wodhida mela Yesuusako shiiqidi, “Astamaariyaw” yaagidi Yesuusa yeeri ekis.
He daro asay Yesuusa oykidosona.
Shin matan eqidaysatape issoy ba mashsha shoddidi kahine halaqaa aylliya shocidi, iya haytha qanxidi holis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, he shiiqida daro asaako, “Tana panga kessidi, panga oykeysada oykanaw mashshenne xam7a oykidi yidetii?
Taani xoossa keethan tamaarsashe, gallas gallas hintera de7iya wode tana oykibeeketa, shin Geeshsha Maxaafay gidaysi poletanaw bessees” yaagis.
Iya tamaareti ubbay iya yeggi aggidi baqatidosona.
Laxana xalaala ma7ida issi na7atetha uray Yesuusa kaalleysa asay oykis.
Shin he uray laxana yeggi aggidi, xire kallo baqatis.
Yesuusi Pirda Shango Sinthan
Asay Yesuusa kahine halaqaa soo efidosona. Yan kahine halaqati, cimatinne higge astamaareti shiiqidi de7oosona.
Phexroosi kahine halaqaa zabbaa gakanaw haahon iya kaalli bidi yan naageysatara uttidi tama kayees.
Kahine halaqatinne shiiqida asa ubbay Yesuusa wodhanaw iya bolla marka koydosona, shin aykoka demmibookona.
Daro asati iya bolla wordo markatidosona, shin enta markatethay issino gidibeenna.

Issi issi asati dendi eqidi Yesuusa bolla, “I, ‘Taani asi keexida ha Xoossa Keetha laallada, asa kushen keexetiboonna hara Xoossa Keetha heedzu gallasa giddon keexana’ gishin nuuni si7ida” yaagidi wordo markatidosona.
Gidoshin, enta markatethay hessanka issino gidibeenna.
Kahine halaqay asa ubba sinthan dendi eqidi, “Haysati nena mootiya mootuwas ne zaariyabay baawee?” yaagidi Yesuusa oychis.
Shin Yesuusi si77i gis; aykoka zaaribeenna. Kahine halaqay, “Anjetida Xoossaa Na7ay, Kiristoosi neneyee?” yaagidi zaari oychis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Ee tana, hinte Asa Na7ay, wolqaama Xoossaafe ushacha baggara uttidashin qassi saluwa shaarara yishin be7ana” yaagis.
Kahine halaqay ba ma7uwa peedhidi, “Nuna hara marka ay koshshii?
Hinte iya cashsha si7ideta; hinte qofay aybee?” yaagis. Enti ubbay, “I hayqanaw bessees” yaagidi iya bolla pirdidosona.
Entafe issoti issoti iya bolla cutethi oykidosona. Iya ayfiya goozidi baqishe, “Nena dechiday oonee? Ane nuus oda!” yaagidosona. Naageysati iya eki efidi garaafidosona.
Phexroosi Yesuusa Kaddis
Phexroosi kahine halaqaa zabban garsa baggara de7ishin, kahine halaqa gadhindotape issiniya ya yasu.
Phexroosi tama kayeysa demmada, tishshi ootha xeellada, “Neka Naazirete Yesuusara de7aasa” yaagasu.
Shin Phexroosi, “Ne geysi aybeko ta erike, taw akeeketena” yaagidi kaddis. Yaagi simmidi, zago keyiya wode iiraka kuttoy waassis.
He gadhindiya Phexroosa be7ada, iya matan eqida asatako, “Ha urayka entara de7ees” gada zaara odasu.
Shin Phexroosi qassika kaddis. Guuthu gam7ishin, matan eqida asati nam7antho Phexroosako, “Neeni Galila biitta asi gidiya gisho tuma entara de7aasa” yaagidosona.
Shin Phexroosi, “Taani hinte giya uraa erike!” yaagidi bana baadethinne caaqo oykis.
Ellesidi kuttoy nam7antho waassi aggis. Phexroosi, Yesuusi iyako, “Neeni kuttoy nam7u toho waassanaape sinthe heedzu toho tana kaddana” gidaysa akeekidi daro yeekis.

footnotes.text: Heedzu xeetu dinaare: Issi asas laythan cigetiya lo77o daamozepe bolla gidiya miishe.
